flags.why: This sector-level term belongs mainly to formal economic writing and needs a register label ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/thuong-nghiep-e28OcJJgEHxqB.html)).

The title could also be conferred on meritorious officials, so restricting recipients to royal relatives is false ([historical study](https://thanhdiavietnamhoc.com/dinh-che-phong-vuong-o-viet-nam-thoi-quan-chu/)).
flags.fix: to confer the title of vương (prince or king)

flags.why: Báo danh does not mean a list of registered candidates; its dictionary meaning is a verb concerning reporting candidates' names ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/B%C3%A1o_danh)).
